parole.significato: mandarin (a high government bureaucrat of Imperial China)
parole.testo: From Malay menteri, manteri, from Sanskrit मन्त्रिन् (mantrin, “minister, councillor”), from मन्त्र (mantra, “counsel, maxim, mantra”) + -इन् (-in, “an agent suffix”). Compare also bailarim, an alternative form of bailarino.
Borrowed from Malay berniaga, from Sanskrit वाणिज्यक (vāṇijyaka).
